# libretro.h

The libretro API header, unmodified, from https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common
(`include/libretro.h`, commit ae22debd425c33fe355ac2e51d9a140d7e8b3fa6).

MIT licence; the licence text is at the top of the header. Only this header is used: no libretro code or core is
shipped with Cinnabarr. Cores are downloaded by the owner (docs/cinnabarr/JELLYFIN.md section 4).
